message.content:
I don’t have real‑time market data, so I can’t give you the exact spot price of gold for today.  The most reliable way to get the current U.S. gold price is to check a reputable financial news site or market data provider such as:

| Source | Typical URL |
|--------|-------------|
| Bloomberg | https://www.bloomberg.com/markets |
| Kitco | https://www.kitco.com/ |
| Reuters | https://www.reuters.com/markets/commodities |
| CNBC | https://www.cnbc.com/commodities/ |

These sites update the spot price of gold (usually quoted in U.S. dollars per troy ounce) every few minutes during market hours. If you need the price for a specific time or for historical comparison, you can also look at the “Gold” section on the U.S. Treasury’s website or use a financial data API (e.g., Bloomberg Terminal, Refinitiv, or free APIs like Metals-API).

If you’re looking for a quick estimate, gold has been trading around **$1,950–$2,050 per ounce** in recent weeks, but that can fluctuate by a few dollars per hour. For the exact figure today, please refer to one of the sources above.
